model.name: diffEditor.interPaneGutters
model.description: Replace the invisible .de-accept-bar bottom bar with slim inter-pane action gutters (Gutter A local<->result, Gutter B result<->repository): per-change icon rows positioned at the change's Result-row Y — left gutter ignore + take-Local, right gutter take-Repo + ignore, magic-wand at conflict rows — wired to the existing acceptChange. Visible on desktop AND phone.
